notes.content:
Adjusted one of the bosses appearing in the game.
Adjusted Gauntlet of Trials.  Timer was extended slightly to aid the player.

notes.title: 2.20 QOL adjustments
notes.content:
2.20 QOL adjustments:

The following adjustments have been address to make the game slightly more manageable for a mixture of classes depending your setup.

-CLASS RELATED-

The Caviler:
Reduced the level requirement for "Recover Me" from LV 20 to 15.
Added "Recover US" when level 20 attained.
Added "Recover Me More" when  level 28 is attained

The Poet:
Song of Valor:  Included with its buff, restores AOE 30 HP to the party.
Invigorate:  Increase recovery from 20% to 25% for healing.
Idealism:  Included with its buff, adds an HP Regen of 5% per round to the party.
Song of Renew:  Along with it's revive of 50%.  The party member that is casted on, will gain a 25% recovery to HP for a brief period of time.
Song of Love:  Increased regen potency from 25% to 30% AOE healing. Additionally, this now removes ALL status effects EXCEPT Toxic.
Song of Evasion:  Included with its buff, restores AOE 50 HP to the party.
Song of Haste:  Included with its buff, restores AOE 100 HP to the party.

-ITEM RELATED-

All recovery herbs have been increased an additional 10%.  (20%, 35%, and 55%).

-OTHER-
HP Regen:  Increase the standard HP regen (unless otherwise specified) from 10% to 25%.
Changed the wording on some skills/items.

notes.title: Slight Minor Fix
notes.content: Fixed an error that skipped boss battles near the end when applying the latest patch.

notes.title: 1.15 QOL Quick Update
notes.content:

Displays Version 1.15 indicating the patch is applied

notes.title: Destinyof a Wizard 2 1.10 QOL Update
notes.content:
Destiny of a Wizard 2:  Beyond the World QOL 1.10 Patch Update.

This patch address several issues most of are which are quality of life improvments to the game and balancing the difficulty.

Change Log:

[u][b]New Game Selection:[/b][/u]

Graphical Display that says "Full Version 1.10" that verifies the game has been patched

[u][b]Dungeon Improvements:[/b][/u]

CH 3:
Added additional two save points in the 2nd Dungeon.
Added Extra Breathing room for the player to maneuver through chase scenes

CH 8:
Added Extra Breathing room for the player to maneuver through chase scenes
Added an additional delay to the repeated sound effect in the chase scene
Added additional guidance for the Tower of Wind from the pitfalls
Increase Windlin's Trial Time Limit from 10 minutes to 13 minutes. 

CH 9:
Increased breathing time to 12 minutes for all water sprouts 

CH 10:
Added Extra Breathing room for the player to maneuver through chase scenes
[u][b]
Class Improvements:[/b][/u]

Reverend:
Decreased Target Rate (likely hood of getting attacked)  from 40% to 10%.
Increased RecoverMe from 15% to 20%
Increased RecoverUs from 15% to 20%
Increased Recover Me More 30% to 40%
Increased Recover Us More to 30% to 40%
Failure rate of Vive of 30% is now 5%, increase Life recovered to 30%
Decreased Revive cost from 60MP to 50MP
Increased Recover Me Most from 50% to 60%
Increased Recover Us Most from 50% to 60%
Decreased Recover Us Max from 115 MP to 100 MP

Tanker:
Increase Target Rate (likely hood of getting attacked) from 130% to 150%
Decreased Cleave TP cost from 35 to 25
Increase WarCry Potency to 40%, Duration to four to six rounds, TP Cost reduced to 40

Cavalier:
Increase Target Rate (likely hood of getting attacked) from 150% to 170%

Clairvoyant:
Increase HP Growth (MAX HP of 2150 at 99 to 3555)
Increase Base Attack  Growth (MAX ATK of 176 at 99 to 245)
Increase Base Defense Growth (MAX DEF of 142 at 99 to 180)
Increase Target Rate (likely hood of getting attacked) from 70% to 30%
Increase Base Critical Rate from 4% to 8% for physical attacks
[u][b]
Item Management:[/b][/u]
Revive Herb 2,500 GP to 1,500 GP
High Mana Potion 400 GP to 300 GP
EX Mana Potion 1,750 GP to 1,350 GP
Minty Herb 1,000 GP to 500 GP

[u][b]Shops:[/b][/u]
Added Minty Herb to all stores in Chapter 8, Chapter 9, and Chapter 10.
[u][b]
Monsters (Including Bosses):[/b][/u]
Starting with Chapter 4:  Decreased all Status Effects, Critical Evasion, Critical Chance, Magic Evasion, Magic Reflection, and Counter Rate significantly.
[u][b]
Weapons:[/b][/u]
Increase MOST weapons attack (after Chapter 4) by 10 points.
